key_findings: Voluntary running reduces PSL-induced thermal hyperalgesia and suppresses PSL-induced FosB+ cell activation in the ventral hippocampal CA1.
Voluntary running increases activation of PV+ and SOM+ GABAergic interneurons in vHPC-CA1 of neuropathic mice, proposed to underlie exercise-induced hypoalgesia.
